title: A landed branch can leave its queue item taken
what: relay land refuses a branch whose taken queue item is still open on it, naming the relay queue done command to run; and a way to close or release an item whose taking branch is gone (landed or deleted), from the main checkout, with the test it was closed by.
why: 29 Oct: relay land landed wt/queue-time-estimates-are-guesses-with-no (check open 0) although its item queue-time-estimates-are-guesses-with-no-model-b was never closed with relay queue done (the cycle stopped at the check, the front recorded owner words and a checker re-check, then landed). After the landing the branch and worktree are gone, the queue still lists the item 'taken by wt/queue-time-estimates-are-guesses-with-no', and `relay queue done` refuses: 'done runs in the worktree of the task branch that took the item'. The same listing shows an-eval-scaffold-overwrote-the-live-relay-bin-re taken by wt/an-eval-scaffold-overwrote-the-live-rela, a branch that no longer exists.
failing_case: land a branch with check open 0 whose item is not closed: it lands, and afterwards relay queue done <slug> refuses everywhere, so the item stays 'taken' by a branch that no longer exists.
pass_cases: relay land of a branch whose taken item is open refuses with exit 2 and names `relay queue done <slug> -C <worktree> --test ...`
an item taken by a branch that no longer exists can be closed (with --test) or released from the main checkout
a branch with no item, or whose item is closed on it, lands as today
